name: r5_union_nat_058
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();s=(p/'src/URMatchingHoleUnion.lean').read_text();a=s.index('  calc\n    _ ≤ q *');b=s.index('\n/-- All rectangles',a)
s=s[:a]+'''  have hs : q * (∑ i ∈ s, (E i).card) ≤ s.card * r := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hi, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
      exact Nat.add_le_add (h i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s))
        (ih (fun j hj => h j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))) |>.trans_eq (Nat.add_comm _ _)
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left q Finset.card_biUnion_le).trans hs
''' + s[b:]
s=s.replace('pow_pos','Nat.pow_pos')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingHoleUnion.lean'],input=s,text=True,check=True)
